name: canvas-to-excalidraw
description: Move selected Canvas nodes into a new Excalidraw drawing and replace them with a link to it.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --format=cjs --target=es2018 --packages=external --charset=utf8 --banner:js="/* GENERATED by esbuild - source lives in src/ */" --outfile=main.js --log-level=info
scripts.ship: npm run build && npm run deploy

author: Junlet
